fit_reason: Whole 18 ft bowrider on trailer listed by a private owner in boats by owner.

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Sea Ray 182 SRX. From the photos, the lower hull and the transom around the outdrive look a bit dull and yellowed, and a gelcoat polish would bring the shine back before buyers see it. We do pre-sale boat details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
